title: design-flywheel
short_summary: Iterative self-improving design flywheel skill for jason-design-agent. Runs an automated multi-turn loop (up to 5 iterations) targeting typography, color, and individual touts using targeted Nano Banana 1K re-renders and micro-research before presenting at the designer checkpoint.
